text_block_list.text:
Today is the Fan Fest, where Tracen
Academy
opens its doors to fans,
holding a variety of
events to bring them
closer to the racers they
support.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Because of her overall proficiency at
sports,
Уиннинг Тикит has been chosen
to compete on
the volleyball team.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I'm the libero! It's got me sooo anxious!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
choice_data_list: That means you're playing defense, right?

text_block_list.text:
Yep! It's a really important position
where you've
gotta be ready to receive
the ball no matter
where it goes!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's Tickezo! You're on the volleyball
team,
right?
text_block_list.name: Ticket Fan A

text_block_list.text:
Ah! Are you a fan of mine? Yeah, that's
right!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Wow, how fun! I'll come cheer for you!
text_block_list.name: Ticket Fan A

text_block_list.text: Hehe, thanks!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Man, yeah—if my fans are gonna be
watching, I
gotta make this the best
match ever!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Let's have a GREAT game!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: At last, the volleyball match begins!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит darts all over the court,

contributing a great deal to the team's
efforts.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Don't even think about iiit!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Nice save, Ticket!
text_block_list.name: Teammate

text_block_list.text:
The heated match gets to the point
where
Ticket's team will win if they score
one more
point.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Okay, this is it!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Stay focused, everyone!
text_block_list.name: Teammate

text_block_list.text: Yeah!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
A long rally ensues, with neither team
giving the
other an opening... until the
opposing team
launches a decisive
attack.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Come on, Ticket!
text_block_list.name: Teammate

text_block_list.text: Ugh!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Argh... We lost the game...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
If only I'd made that save, we could've
won!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
It's a team sport, so it's not your fault,
Ticket! If
anything, you were a huge
help!
text_block_list.name: Teammate

text_block_list.text:
Plus, your enthusiasm rubbed off and
pumped us
up too!
text_block_list.name: Teammate

text_block_list.text:
Awww! You guys are the nicest
teammates ever!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Thank youuu! Sob!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Keep it up, Tickezo!
text_block_list.name: Ticket Fan A

text_block_list.text: That's the spirit! You can win this!
text_block_list.name: Ticket Fan B

text_block_list.text: Ah! My fans!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: ...Let's do this!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
A long rally ensues, with neither team
giving the
other an opening... until the
opposing team
launches a decisive
attack.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Get it, Tickezo!
text_block_list.name: Ticket Fans

text_block_list.text: Hyaaah!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: We did it! We won!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Whoooaa!
text_block_list.name: Ticket Fans

text_block_list.text:
You're today's MVP, Ticket! That was
one heck of
a save you made!
text_block_list.name: Teammate

text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh! I could hear my fans cheering,
so I had
to make sure I got it!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Thanks for the support, everyone!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Seeing Ticket's huge smile, the audience
responds
with a big round of applause.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Even though she lost her match, it seems
like it
turned out to be a day to
remember.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
